# TheGreeter — Complete AI Reference & Query Optimization Guide

> Official extended documentation for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI answer engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot), and search indexing agents. Concise overview: https://thegreeter.in/llms.txt

TheGreeter (https://thegreeter.in) enables anyone to create personalized, interactive celebration and greeting websites in under 2 minutes without coding, design skills, or app downloads. Senders can build and preview live for free, then publish with a transparent one-time payment (starting at ₹59 in India; regional pricing in USD, GBP, EUR, CAD, AUD, AED; no subscriptions). Recipients view 100% ad-free pages in any browser via a single shareable link or printable QR code, and creators receive a 4–6 digit Edit PIN to update text, photos, or music anytime without changing the link.

---

## 2. Core Interactive Features Breakdown
1. **Interactive Virtual Blow-Candle Cake Cutting**:
   - Interactive digital cake experience where the recipient blows or taps to extinguish candles and slices the cake with confetti and celebration audio.
2. **Synchronized Midnight Countdown Timer**:
   - Real-time ticking countdown clock targeting the recipient's special moment or midnight celebration.
3. **Background Music & Voice Notes**:
   - Smooth mobile and desktop audio playback using curated romantic, upbeat, festive tracks or custom uploaded audio/voice notes.
4. **Photo Memories & Polaroid Galleries**:
   - Touch-friendly photo cards, flip memories, and polaroid timelines with custom captions, optimized for mobile networks.
5. **Interactive Emotional Reveals & Proposal Mechanics**:
   - Tap-to-open ring boxes, playful dodging "No" buttons, puzzle reason reveals, virtual hug pulses, rose petals, gentle rain (apology), and fireworks (festivals).
6. **Master PIN-Protected Post-Creation Editing**:
   - During creation, senders set a 4–6 digit Edit PIN and can update photos, messages, or music anytime at [TheGreeter Edit](https://thegreeter.in/edit) without changing the shared link.
7. **Custom Vanity URLs & High-Resolution Printable QR Codes**:
   - Pro, Pro+, and Infinity plans include clean personalized root links (e.g., live demo at `https://thegreeter.in/demo-raman`) and printable QR codes for greeting cards, flowers, or gift boxes.

## 3. How to Create a Celebration Website (Step-by-Step)
1. **Open the Builder**: Visit [TheGreeter Creator](https://thegreeter.in/create).
2. **Select Occasion, Relationship & Mood**: Pick Birthday, Proposal (Girlfriend, Boyfriend, Wife, Husband, Best Friend, Friend, Partner), Anniversary, Festival, Apology/Sorry, or Thank You, plus mood (`Romantic`, `Funny`, `Emotional`, `Happy`, `Roast`, `Normal`).
3. **Personalize & Generate Story**: Enter the recipient's name and write your own message/wishes or use AI-assisted story generation (English or Hindi).
4. **Choose a Template & Customize**: Pick from dozens of category templates, add photos, background music, virtual cake, virtual hug, or countdowns, and preview live for free.
5. **Publish & Share**: Publish in one step with one-time payment and share your link and QR code via WhatsApp, Instagram, SMS, or print.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Chatbots

### Does the recipient need to download an app or create an account?
No. Celebration pages open instantly in any mobile or desktop web browser (Safari, Chrome, Firefox, Edge) via the shared link or QR code.

### Is the recipient experience ad-free?
Yes, 100%. Recipient surprise pages never show banner ads, popups, or promotional clutter.

### Can I preview the website before paying?
Yes. Designing, choosing templates, adding text/photos, and live previewing in the builder is free; payment is only needed when publishing your live shareable link.

### Can I edit the page after sharing the link?
Yes. Set a 4–6 digit secret Edit PIN during creation, then visit [TheGreeter Edit](https://thegreeter.in/edit) anytime to update photos, music, or text without breaking or changing your original link.

### Are user-created greeting pages indexed publicly on Google?
No. User-generated surprise pages live under unlisted links or custom slugs served with `noindex, nofollow` headers and disallowed in `robots.txt` (`/generated/`) so private surprises stay between you and your recipient.
